description: `msg-to-mailbox` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the standard `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), composes an email from those fields, and sends it from the platform's domain (svcpass.com). Two delivery channels are available: the free `default` channel delivers to the address stored in your `UNITYSVC_NOTIFY_EMAIL` secret; the `plus` channel delivers to a recipient you choose per enrollment via the `to` parameter, at $0.001 per message.
name: msg-to-mailbox
summary: Accepts an HTTP request in the unified `msg` format and delivers it to you as email, using a pre-configured destination — no SMTP server or email-provider API key of your own required.

request.template: {"to":["${ customer_secrets.UNITYSVC_NOTIFY_EMAIL }"],"title":{* _escape_json(_body.title or "") *},"body":{* _escape_json(_body.body or _body.message or "") *},"type":{* _escape_json(_body.type or "info") *},"format":{* _escape_json(_body.format or "text") *}}
